audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1], whys[4] and mid all say Infinite Duress 'pins Sion through his knockups'.
audit.why: Warwick's R is a channelled leap-suppress; a charged Decimating Smash knockup-stun or an Unstoppable Onslaught collision knocks him out of it. The already-audited sion__warwick mirror teaches Sion exactly that, so the page was arming the opponent.
audit.corrected: Ordering reversed: ult only after his charged Q (10s at rank 1) or R is spent.
sources: Sion kit Q and R 'hardCC'/knockup text

audit.whatIsWrong: The late spike says Sion's HP stacking means your damage cannot chew through him.
audit.why: Jaws of the Beast deals damage based on the target's maximum health, so the one tank whose whole identity is stacking max HP is the tank Warwick's Q scales into. The page had the interaction backwards in the field where it matters most.
audit.corrected: Late spike now states that his max-health stacking feeds your bite while naming his real threats (knockup Q, shield W, ult engage).
sources: Warwick kit Q 'percentHealth' flag and text

audit.why: Both layers already agree row for row and match the packet chart and the 55.11% win rate: Warwick owns levels 2-5, Sion owns the two-item stage. Left untouched — but see the question below, because the mirror recorded the opposite chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: The most punishable cooldown was named without its length.
audit.why: Decimating Smash is 10/9/8/7/6s — long enough at rank 1 to be a real all-in window, which is what makes sidestepping the charge worth doing.
audit.corrected: 10s rank-1 window written into the Do's and the mid text.

edits.before: Level 6 favours you: R Infinite Duress pins Sion through his knockups for a burst window.
edits.after: Level 6 favours you: ult once his charged Q is spent — a knockup cancels your R.

edits.before: R Infinite Duress locks Sion out of his own Q charge and E Roar of the Slayer knockback — ult mid-CS and burst him, but respect his passive: killing him revives an angry zombie.
edits.after: A charged Decimating Smash or Unstoppable Onslaught knocks you out of Infinite Duress mid-channel — ult only after one is spent, and remember killing him wakes an angry zombie.

edits.before: Late Sion is a wall of HP with a knock-up Q, a shield W, and a game-ending R Unstoppable Onslaught engage — your single-target damage can't chew through him and you become peel-fodder.
edits.after: Late Sion is a wall of HP with a knockup Q, a shield W, and a game-ending Unstoppable Onslaught — but Jaws of the Beast scales off his max health, so his stacking feeds your bite.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 are yours. Blood Hunt speed lets you juke the Q charge and punish it on cooldown, Q sustain keeps you healthy, and R at 6 pins him through his knockups — just don't int into his passive revive.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 are yours. Blood Hunt speed lets you juke the Q charge and punish its 10s cooldown, Q sustain keeps you healthy, and at 6 you ult only once his charged Q is spent — a knockup cancels it.

edits.before: Charged = knockup. Sidestep it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Charged = knockup — sidestep it, then commit in its 10s rank-1 window.
